title: Filipino Fried Rice with Almonds
description: A simple and delicious Filipino-style fried rice dish made with almonds, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced almonds and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the rice is heated through.
Add the stir-fry mix and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions if desired.
